summary_en: Introduces FLSFusionNet for camera-sonar joint forward-looking-sonar segmentation. The framework uses separate sonar and camera backbones, a camera-sonar spatial transformer to bridge heterogeneous representations, adaptive cross-modal fusion for semantic consistency, and a fusion-based segmentation head, improving robustness in noisy and visually challenging underwater scenes.

summary_en: Presents AOMNet for joint underwater object detection from weakly aligned sonar and optical-camera imagery. It combines a cross-feature and predicted-position middle-fusion module with decision-level registration and bounding-box refinement, explicitly addressing spatial, scale, and texture mismatch between acoustic and optical observations.
